pondParts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE modular sprite-parts sheet for a ground-level dry pit / water puddle asset for ANIMOL. The reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match bold near-black navy angular outlines, green grass/moss, warm tan/brown cut soil and cyan/teal water, broad flat cel-shaded color masses. This is a square-grid top-down 2D puzzle tile, viewed from above with a tiny inner front soil lip, equal X/Y ground scale, no vanishing point. NOT a dam, gate, canal machine, raised pool, cream masonry structure or lever. A low square-ish depression cut directly into grass; corners are softly chamfered but drawn with clean angular segments. The empty dry depression is a WALKABLE bare soil bottom; the filled depression is a cyan water puddle, same exact location and shape. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Arrange EXACTLY 8 clearly separated parts in a regular FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW sheet, equal-size cells with generous TRANSPARENT gutters, NO labels or text. Parts ordered row-major: (1) the low green-grass and brown-soil rim ONLY, with a genuinely transparent OPEN CENTER, identical outer silhouette intended for every state; (2) an isolated square/chamfered warm dry-soil interior PLANE, no rim; (3) isolated interior plane 20 percent filled with cyan water at its south/bottom edge and remaining dry soil; (4) same interior plane 40 percent filled; (5) same interior plane 60 percent filled; (6) same interior plane 80 percent filled; (7) same interior plane completely filled with cyan/teal water and two simple cream ripple marks; (8) a few cream ripple marks ONLY on transparency, no floor plane. All interior planes have IDENTICAL square proportions and pixel-scale; horizontal front/back edges equal width and depth edges vertical, not trapezoid. No terrain island, deep void, walls, plinth, pipes, metal pieces, mechanical parts, arrow signs, grass blade noise, tiny texture speckles, blurry gradients, glow or shadows outside the depression. This is parts for one natural-looking pit/puddle that can fill and drain, not 8 different pit designs.

sheepVanish.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE four-frame horizontal VFX sprite strip for the supplied ANIMOL cream-fleeced angular cartoon sheep vanishing AFTER it eats grass. The attached sheep is a STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE only, do not redraw a living sheep, face, eyes or body in these effects. Use a small cream/ivory wool-puff burst, a few soft gold and pale leaf-green accents, bold crisp deep navy outlines and simple flat angular wedge-shaped pieces. EXACTLY four separated same-size cells with transparent gutters: frame1 small dense compact cream wool puff; frame2 puff opens into a few separated broad wool tufts; frame3 only four tiny fading tufts near centre; frame4 only one or two very small final flecks, mostly empty transparency. Keep same centre and scale progression, no explosions, no stars/symbols that imply a new reward, no ghost sheep, no blood, no text, no labels, no background rectangle, no gradient fog. This is a gentle puzzle-game disappearance, not damage. Actual transparent RGBA background; 4 columns x1 row, clear gutters.
